technical.summary: ROST shows solid bullish structure with price above all major MAs, Ichimoku cross-up, and three white soldiers pattern, but MACD divergence and moderate ADX limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ROST shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 33 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (bearish 36.7% vs bullish 28.4%) with neutral fear-greed reading (59 = Greed) provides no clear directional bias; absence of recent news data limits sentiment confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (183.2) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 33 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for discretionary consumer stock.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with Ichimoku cross-up and three white soldiers pattern suggests near-term bullish structure and momentum continuation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 183.2), MACD divergence, moderate ADX, below-average volume, high earnings risk in 33 days, and weak fundamental/sentiment signals create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
